transcript.text: Hi there! I'd love to chat and figure out how your mind works. To start us off: after a long, demanding week, what does your ideal evening look like?

Oh, long weeks are the worst—gotta shake that off immediately! I’d hit up this downtown rooftop bar with a live band and grab a cold margarita the second I clock out. Zero plans, just seeing who's around, dancing under the lights, and letting the night take me wherever it goes!
That sounds like such an electric way to decompress! When your mind wanders and nothing is demanding your attention, what kind of things do you find yourself thinking about?

Honestly, I barely sit still long enough for my mind to wander, but when it does, it's usually daydreaming about a last-minute weekend road trip to the beach or wishing I was at that outdoor concert down the street. Who has time to overthink when there's so much fun stuff happening right now?
You really love staying right in the action! Tell me about a time you had to give someone news they wouldn't like. What went through your mind, and what did you actually do?

Oh man, I am the worst at heavy conversations—I totally sweat through my shirt just thinking about it! When I had to tell my roommate I accidentally dented her favorite surfboard, I just blurted it out immediately over takeout pizza and offered to pay for repairs with my weekend cash. No use beating around the bush or overcomplicating things; just rip the band-aid off and make it right!
Rip the band-aid off and make it right—I love that direct approach! Walk me through how you handled your last big trip, move, or deadline.

Oh, you do *not* want to see my packing style—it’s pure chaos right up until the Uber arrives! For my last beach trip, I literally threw a bikini, some cutoff shorts, and a toothbrush into a duffel bag ten minutes before leaving, and just figured out a place to sleep once we hit the coast.
Before we wrap up, tell me about something specific you've been curious about lately. What was it, and why did it catch your attention?

Oh, I've been totally obsessed with finding the best street tacos in the city lately! A guy at a red light last week told me about this sketchy-looking food truck behind an auto shop, and now I'm on a mission to taste-test my way through every single hot sauce they have.
